email_subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoCardolol patient with mild fatigue
email_body:
[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a nurse practitioner at Demo Regional Hospital (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 56-year-old male patient with a history of hypertension received their third dose of DemoCardolol (dose: 10mg) via oral.
Treatment started on 2026-01-16.
Approximately 8 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed mild fatigue.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
A. Okafor (fictional reporter)
Demo Regional Hospital
Contact: demo.reporter753@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
